preservation.ancestor_figure_and_marks: All outside the bare-stone addition rectangle; preserved pixel for pixel.
preservation.protected_hash_order: RGB bytes, row major, excluding rectangle [500,175,720,375].

method: Installed imagegen tool generated isolated pigment. FFmpeg decoded bytes; standard-library Python composited only the new mark on bare rock, preserving the original PNG pixels outside that region. FFmpeg encoded the required JPEG. No media dependency was installed.

visual_review.method: Agent inspected inherited PNG, finished PNG and final JPEG with view_image.
visual_review.ancestral_pepe: Wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes, face, body, basket and trails retained in their original pixels.
visual_review.digit_description: Four fingers and one thumb on each inherited hand; no added hands or handprints.
visual_review.addition: Small worn pair of flints bound by one red ochre cord and knot on bare stone above Pepe.
visual_review.style: Warm torchlit rock, charcoal, ochre and chalk; uneven sparse pigment with rock showing through.
visual_review.prohibited_marks: No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people, political or hateful symbols observed.
visual_review.framing: 1254-pixel square; rock, cracks, lighting and framing unchanged outside the small addition.

limitations: Visual review is one worker observation, not independent approval.
The new flint mark is pale and has finer detail than the inherited burnt-stick figure.
Only pigment in the stated bare-rock rectangle is changed; no claim that painted rock pixels there remain identical.
